items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve; signed Jaleel McLaughlin from PS.
items.implication: Judkins lead but low routes so far; Sanders/McLaughlin committee.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per reports, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year. Scary history. Kubiak calls day-to-day.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery ahead of schedule; coach day-to-day label.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Michael Mayer temporary TE1 if out.

items.text: Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, monitored throughout week; status up in the air vs Raiders. Harbaugh: day-to-day, see how he feels.
items.why: Rib injury from hit; testing and monitoring this week.
items.implication: If out, Tre Harris and slot options rise; huge for Chargers pass catchers.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; would have returned if playoff game. MRI upcoming but day-to-day. Coach Minter confirms positive.
items.why: Not serious per sources; prior preseason issue but optimistic.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or soon; Bateman/others temporary if misses.

items.text: Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman; Kamara=Miller; Sampson=Sanders; Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Murray=Wentz; Darnold=Lock. Streamers and FAAB guidance.
items.why: Precise injury fallout maps to available players.
items.implication: Prioritize Miller, Wentz (if Murray out), Harris if McConkey misses.

items.text: A.J. Brown high ankle sprain placed on IR, expected ~6 weeks per reports.
items.why: High ankle more severe than initial; multi-week absence.
items.implication: NE WR depth rises (Doubs etc); long-term stash.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, only 2.5 last night with just 2 targets (7% share). Routes strong: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30).
items.why: High route participation but microscopic aDOT and low target share limit upside without volume spike.
items.implication: Needs heavy target volume to produce; monitor for role expansion.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Near-total early opportunity share plus receiving involvement confirms three-down role.
items.implication: Elite RB1 volume ROS in KC offense.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att +6 tgt for 156 yds 2 TD. High-end RB1 every-down player; upgrades ROS.
items.why: Dominant utilization score 99; improved YBC/YAC behind better OL.
items.implication: Lock RB1; history of high rush+target shares yields 23+ PPG.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/ Etienne, 26 Miller, 15 Donaldson; routes 24/7/5; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Three-way split despite Kamara absence; limited routes.
items.implication: Etienne low-end RB2; Miller handcuff/beneficiary if Kamara returns limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Immediate high route/target share on limited snaps post-injury.
items.implication: WR1 upside as snaps ramp; healthy return.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after MNF explosion. Strong love; Monday Night Miracle for those who started him.
items.why: Dominant performance confirms workhorse role post-trade to KC.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Sampson (knee) early exit. Browns used third-stringer Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite backup injury.
items.implication: Limited three-down upside; committee risk with Sampson IR.

items.text: Bucky Irving 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). Only RB carry inside 10. Out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Healthy look, good CLE matchup.
items.why: Goal-line and route edge over Gainwell despite modest carries.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 with receiving/GL work; points slightly overstated but role solid.
